{
  "file_path": "/tmp/build_memo_part1.py",
  "content": "# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Content module: Sections I-III of the witness-interview outline memorandum."""

MEMO_HEADER = {
    "to": "Presiding Partner, IP Litigation Group; Meridian Dynamics, Inc. Matter Team",
    "from": "IP Litigation Group — Internal Fact Investigation Team",
    "date": "September 20, 2026",
    "re": ("SkyVault Technologies LLC v. Meridian Dynamics, Inc., No. 2:24-cv-00817-JRG "
           "(E.D. Tex., Marshall Division) — Witness Interview Outline and Preparation "
           "Memorandum (Dr. Marcus Holt; Meridian Technical Team; Meridian Legal Lead)"),
    "priv": ("PRIVILEGED AND CONFIDENTIAL — ATTORNEY-CLIENT COMMUNICATION — "
             "ATTORNEY WORK PRODUCT — PREPARED IN ANTICIPATION OF LITIGATION"),
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Section I
S1 = [
 ("h1", "I.  PURPOSE, SCOPE, AND LIMITS OF THIS MEMORANDUM"),
 ("p", "This memorandum is an interview-design document. Its purpose is to tell the matter team "
       "what to ask three categories of witness, why each question matters, and which of the five "
       "supplied materials supplies the factual lead behind each question. It is prepared at the "
       "request of the presiding partner in connection with a privileged internal fact investigation "
       "of the allegations SkyVault Technologies LLC has asserted against Meridian Dynamics, Inc."),
 ("p", "This memorandum is not, and must not be treated as, testimony, a declaration, a pleading, an "
       "infringement or claim chart, a non-infringement opinion, a settlement communication, an "
       "independent-development opinion, or a prediction of outcome on the merits. No question below "
       "assumes that any allegation in the complaint is true, and no question assumes that any "
       "position Meridian has taken is true. Where the supplied materials state a contested proposition, "
       "the proposition is treated below as a lead to be developed, not as a fact to be recited."),
 ("p", "Only the five materials listed in Part II have been used as sources of in-package fact. Where "
       "a question depends on personnel files, source-code repositories, development records, "
       "preservation records, internal communications, compliance materials, the complete forensic "
       "population, or any technical comparison, that dependency is expressed as an interview "
       "confirmation or a document-collection request. Nothing of that kind is assumed to exist, and "
       "nothing of that kind is treated here as established."),
 ("p", "One limitation is stated expressly because it constrains several questions below. The March 12, "
       "2024 cease-and-desist letter from Callister, Voss & Greenbaum LLP to Meridian was not supplied. "
       "Its contents are known to us only through Complaint paragraph 61 and through the matters that "
       "Meridian's April 5, 2024 response addresses. Nothing in this memorandum attributes to that "
       "letter any content, tone, deadline, enclosures, or demand beyond those two sources, and "
       "interviewers must observe the same limit."),
 ("h2", "A.  Structure of this memorandum"),
 ("p", "Part II assesses each supplied material and states what it can and cannot prove; it also lists "
       "the material that is missing. Part III states the drafting conventions used for every question. "
       "Parts IV, V, and VI contain the three witness sections. Part VII gives a recommended interview "
       "sequence with reasons. Appendix A consolidates the collection requests generated by the "
       "questions, so that each identified gap is tied to a named item and a custodian."),
 ("h2", "B.  Coverage of the required lead families"),
 ("p", "Six lead families are carried through the questions below, and each appears in more than one "
       "witness section so that the accounts can be cross-checked:"),
 ("bullet", "Holt's employment and access history — Questions H-1 through H-8; corroborated at T-7, T-8, L-5."),
 ("bullet", "Holt's disclosed prior work — Questions H-9 through H-14 (ECIAA Exhibit A); corroborated at T-3, T-4, L-5."),
 ("bullet", "PathForge development origins — Questions H-15 through H-20; corroborated at T-1, T-2, T-5, T-10."),
 ("bullet", "White paper title and authorship information — Questions H-21 through H-24; corroborated at T-6, T-11, L-12."),
 ("bullet", "DroneNav and other public sources — Questions H-25 through H-29; corroborated at T-3, T-4, L-4, L-7."),
 ("bullet", "Pre-suit correspondence chain — Questions H-30, H-31, L-2, L-3, L-6, L-8, L-10, L-11; corroborated at T-9."),

 # ---------------------------------------------------------------- Section II
 ("h1", "II.  MATERIALS REVIEWED AND THEIR ACTUAL EVIDENTIARY REACH"),
 ("p", "Each of the five supplied materials proves a different and narrower thing than the use to which "
       "an adversary would put it. The assessments below govern how every question in Parts IV through "
       "VI is framed. Interviewers should read this Part before conducting any interview."),

 ("h2", "A.  skyvault-complaint.docx — a pleading, and therefore SkyVault's assertions"),
 ("p", "Plaintiff's Original Complaint, dated October 2, 2024, filed in the Eastern District of Texas, "
       "Marshall Division, as Civil Action No. 2:24-cv-00817-JRG, with 151 numbered allegations, nine "
       "counts, a prayer for relief, a jury demand, a certificate of service, and an exhibit list."),
 ("p", "What it establishes: what SkyVault alleges, which patents and registrations it asserts, what it "
       "demands, and when it says it acted. Paragraph 61 is our only in-package description of the "
       "March 12, 2024 letter. Paragraph 62 and the April 5 response fix the pre-suit exchange."),
 ("p", "What it does not establish: misappropriation, infringement, access, copying, willfulness, "
       "damages, or SkyVault's ownership or validity positions. The great majority of the operative "
       "factual allegations are expressly qualified — see paragraphs 2, 12, 49, 54, 55, 59, 60, 69, 78, "
       "86, 94, 95, 107, 108, 119, 120, 130, and 146, each pleaded \"on information and belief.\" The "
       "claim chart at paragraph 67 is one party's mapping of claim language onto a marketing document; "
       "it is not a technical finding, and paragraph 67 itself introduces it \"[b]y way of example and "
       "without limitation.\" Exhibits A through D are listed but not supplied, and Exhibit G is supplied "
       "only in part."),

 ("h2", "B.  meridian-cd-response.docx — Meridian's own party position, made through counsel"),
 ("p", "Letter dated April 5, 2024 from Laura Brackwell, Partner, Brackwell & Haines LLP, Austin, Texas, "
       "to Theresa N. Voss, Partner, Callister, Voss & Greenbaum LLP, Dallas, Texas, sent \"Via Email and "
       "U.S. Certified Mail,\" cc to Jordan Kessler, VP of Legal, Meridian Dynamics, Inc."),
 ("p", "What it establishes: what Meridian said to SkyVault's counsel on April 5, 2024, and which demands "
       "it declined — cessation of manufacture, use, sale and distribution; the $15 million licensing fee; "
       "and access to source-code repositories for forensic audit. It also records a reservation of "
       "non-infringement, invalidity, unenforceability, and independent-development defenses, an offer of "
       "without-prejudice discussions, and a request that SkyVault refrain from contacting Meridian's "
       "officers and employees directly."),
 ("p", "What it does not establish: the truth of any statement it makes. The letter says of itself that it "
       "is written \"without waiver of any rights, claims, or defenses\" and that \"[n]othing in this letter "
       "constitutes an admission of any fact, allegation, liability, or wrongdoing of any kind.\" Its "
       "denials, its statement that \"Meridian independently developed its PathForge platform through the "
       "efforts of its engineering teams,\" and its statement that \"Meridian maintains robust internal "
       "compliance processes designed to safeguard against the unauthorized use of third-party "
       "intellectual property\" are representations, not proof of independent development, not proof that "
       "compliance processes exist, and not proof that no third-party material entered PathForge. Each is "
       "an affirmative factual assertion already made in writing to opposing counsel, and each therefore "
       "requires a documentary foundation before it is repeated. That requirement drives the sequencing "
       "recommendation in Part VII."),

 ("h2", "C.  pathforge-whitepaper-excerpt.docx — a 2022 public technical and marketing statement"),
 ("p", "\"PathForge: Next-Generation Autonomous Navigation,\" PathForge White Paper v1.0, July 2022, "
       "cover-attributed to \"Dr. Marcus Holt, CTO and Co-Founder / PathForge Engineering Team / Meridian "
       "Dynamics, Inc.,\" classified on its face as \"Public Release / Marketing Technical Paper,\" and "
       "expressly \"an excerpt of the full PathForge Technical White Paper (42 pages)\" containing "
       "\"Sections 1-5 and Section 7, omitting detailed hardware specifications (Section 6) and appendices.\""),
 ("p", "What it establishes: that Meridian published these statements in July 2022, and what it said. Its "
       "prior-art narrative — the Vasquez (2016) paper, the DroneNav open-source project first committed "
       "August 15, 2017, Nakamura and Okonkwo (2015), and Ferreira et al. (2016) — is Meridian's own "
       "public characterization of PathForge's foundations, and is usable against SkyVault's secrecy "
       "position to that extent."),
 ("p", "What it does not establish: that PathForge was in fact developed from the ground up or "
       "independently. Statements such as \"Developed from the ground up beginning in 2018\" (Section 1) "
       "and \"All PathForge technology was developed independently by the Meridian engineering team\" "
       "(Section 7.2) are self-serving published assertions by the party now accused; they are potential "
       "party admissions if untrue, not evidence of truth. The benchmark tables in Sections 3.3, 4.4 and "
       "5.4 are unverified published figures. The cover attribution is a publication credit, not a "
       "verified statement of who wrote what. And because the excerpt is partial, the absence of a term "
       "from it proves nothing about the complete paper — a point of direct consequence for Question H-22."),

 ("h2", "D.  holt-eciaa-agreement.docx — a contract and a prior-invention disclosure"),
 ("p", "Employee Confidentiality and Invention Assignment Agreement between SkyVault Technologies LLC and "
       "Dr. Marcus Holt, effective and dated June 13, 2016, comprising recitals, Sections 1 through 10, a "
       "signature page executed by Dr. Rajan Mehta for SkyVault and by Dr. Marcus Holt, and Exhibit A "
       "(Prior Inventions Disclosure), initialed \"_M.H._\" and dated June 13, 2016."),
 ("p", "What it establishes: the parties, the effective date, the position and reporting line (Section 1.1), "
       "the defined terms (Section 2), the confidentiality and return-of-materials obligations (Sections "
       "3.1-3.5, including the Section 3.5(c) duty to \"certify in writing\"), the residual-skills "
       "preservation (Section 3.4), the systems and removable-media rules (Sections 4.1-4.2), the "
       "invention-disclosure, assignment, exclusion, and work-made-for-hire framework (Sections 5.1-5.4), "
       "the twelve-month non-solicitation period (Section 7.1), the remedies and Texas forum provisions "
       "(Sections 8-9), and the two Prior Inventions listed on Exhibit A — an \"Autonomous Ground Vehicle "
       "Path Planning Algorithm\" (2014-2015, Georgia Institute of Technology doctoral research, no patent "
       "filed) and the \"RoboNav Sensor Calibration Toolkit (open-source)\" (2015, MIT License, "
       "github.com/mholt-robotics/robonav-cal)."),
 ("p", "What it does not establish: that any obligation was breached; that any invention was conceived or "
       "reduced to practice during employment; that the Exhibit A items were or were not used at Meridian; "
       "that Holt did or did not return materials or deliver a Section 3.5(c) certification; or anything "
       "about conduct after June 13, 2016. Exhibit A is a snapshot of pre-employment work as of that date, "
       "and it is silent on everything after it. Note also that the agreement is silent as to whether the "
       "listed items were ever actually used, and that its existence does not make its Exhibit A a complete "
       "inventory of Holt's pre-2016 work."),

 ("h2", "E.  exhibit-f-forensic-log.xlsx — a SkyVault-side selected extract"),
 ("p", "\"SkyVault Technologies LLC — Confluence Workspace IT Forensic Log Extract,\" designated \"Exhibit F\" "
       "in this action, prepared by Hargrove Forensics Group for Callister, Voss & Greenbaum LLP, report "
       "dated March 5, 2018, forensic examiner Thomas R. Hargrove, CFCE, EnCE, and marked \"CONFIDENTIAL — "
       "ATTORNEY WORK PRODUCT / PREPARED IN ANTICIPATION OF LITIGATION.\" Two visible worksheets: \"Report "
       "Metadata\" (cells A1:B14) and \"Forensic Log\" (cells A1:U51, header row 1, 50 event rows, "
       "freeze pane at A2, autofilter A1:U51)."),
 ("p", "What it establishes: what SkyVault's own systems logged against the account \"mholt\" and what its "
       "administrators wrote in the incident record. It is a party-commissioned vendor product, not a "
       "neutral or court-appointed finding."),
 ("p", "What it does not establish, and five features of the extract that must be put to witnesses rather "
       "than assumed:"),
 ("num", "It is not the population. \"Report Metadata\" cell B13 states that the extract \"contains selected "
         "events relevant to the bulk file transfer incident involving user mholt on 02/09/2018\" and that the "
         "\"[f]ull audit log contains 12,847 events for the review period; 50 events selected as relevant to "
         "the scope of engagement.\" Cell B9 states \"Total Events in Scope: 50.\" The 50 rows are therefore "
         "an advocacy selection of roughly 0.4 percent of the population, and no inference about what did not "
         "happen can be drawn from them."),
 ("num", "It is not a file-level manifest. \"Forensic Log\" Row # 34, the headline BULK_COPY_TO_REMOVABLE "
         "event, records a File/Object Name of \"[Multiple — see File Count]\" and a File Count of 4,700 with "
         "a Total Size of 18,473.2 MB. No list of the 4,700 files, no per-file hashes, and no verification "
         "against the destination appears anywhere in the extract. The assertion in Complaint paragraphs 49, "
         "94, 107 and 129 that the download included all five trade-secret categories TS-1 through TS-5 rests "
         "on the Confluence space names in the Row # 34 Notes field, not on any identified file."),
 ("num", "Its own date and time columns disagree about the headline event. Row # 34 carries Timestamp (UTC) "
         "\"2018-02-09T02:18:12Z,\" Event Date \"02/09/2018,\" and Event Time (CT) \"08:18:12 PM (02/08 CT).\" "
         "The same pattern appears at Row # 33 (USB_DEVICE_CONNECTED, \"08:17:44 PM (02/08 CT)\") and Row # 35 "
         "(USB_DEVICE_DISCONNECTED, \"09:42:58 PM (02/08 CT)\"). On the extract's own Central-time column the "
         "entire USB episode occurred on the evening of February 8, 2018, while Complaint paragraphs 48, 50, "
         "94, 107 and 128(a) all plead February 9, 2018. Other rows convert without discrepancy — Row # 32 "
         "(\"2018-02-08T22:44:06Z\" to \"04:44:06 PM\") and Rows # 36-37 — so the annotation appears "
         "deliberate and the Event Date column appears keyed to the UTC date."),
 ("num", "The staged transfers do not account for the headline transfer. Rows # 27 through # 32 record six "
         "BULK_EXPORT events between February 2 and February 8, 2018 from Confluence to "
         "\"Local Disk (C:\\Users\\mholt\\Downloads\\export_MMDDYY)\": 347 files / 1,842.6 MB "
         "(/Engineering/SensorFusion/Archives/); 218 / 1,105.3 (/Engineering/FlightPath/); 189 / 924.7 "
         "(/Engineering/SwarmProtocol/); 276 / 2,214.8 (/Engineering/HardwareIntegration/); 412 / 3,127.4 "
         "(/Engineering/SensorFusion/); and 84 / 467.2 (/Business/CustomerData/). Those six rows total 1,526 "
         "files and 9,682.0 MB. Row # 34 records 4,700 files and 18,473.2 MB reaching the USB device. Within "
         "the 50 selected rows, 3,174 files and 8,791.2 MB — roughly 68 percent of the file count and 48 "
         "percent of the volume — are unaccounted for."),
 ("num", "It does not reach source code at all. \"Report Metadata\" cell B7 limits the Scope of Review to "
         "\"All Confluence workspace and endpoint security events for user account 'mholt' ... during the "
         "period January 1, 2018 through February 28, 2018,\" and cell B8 lists the Data Sources as \"SkyVault "
         "Confluence Server v6.12.2 audit logs; Endpoint Security Agent (v4.1) event logs; Active Directory "
         "authentication logs; USB device connection registry.\" No source-code management system is within "
         "scope. Consistently with that, no row among Rows # 1 through # 50 mentions AeroCore, "
         "navfusion.c, pathoptengine.h, swarm_proto.cpp, or any version-control system — the very files named "
         "in Complaint paragraphs 33, 116 and 118. The actual event dates also run only from January 3 to "
         "February 16, 2018, not through February 28; and although the stated scope is the \"mholt\" account, "
         "12 of the 50 rows are attributed to \"bthornton\" (8 rows) or \"SYSTEM\" (4 rows). The \"Reviewed "
         "By\" and \"Review Date\" columns are populated for only 10 of the 50 rows and are blank for every "
         "one of the 38 \"mholt\" rows."),
 ("p", "Two further features bear on handling and on cross-examination. First, cell B12 records chain of "
       "custody as \"Server image acquired 02/19/2018 by T. Hargrove; verified hash SHA-256: 9a3f...d82e; "
       "stored in evidence locker HFG-2018-0034\" — a truncated hash, for a server image, with no "
       "device-level custody record for the SanDisk media identified at Rows # 33-35 by the identifier "
       "\"USB\\VID_0781&PID_5581\\4C530001221029118035 (SanDisk Ultra 128GB).\" Second, the file bears "
       "SkyVault's attorney-work-product legend at cell B14 yet was filed as a public complaint exhibit; "
       "the matter team should confirm how Meridian came to hold it before it is shown to any witness, "
       "since that affects both handling and any later challenge."),
 ("p", "Finally, the extract contains a timing tension with the pleading that no supplied document resolves. "
       "Rows # 38 through # 50 record, between February 12 and February 16, 2018, an automated alert "
       "(reference ALT-2018-0209-0041), escalation to HR under incident ticket INC-2018-00417, a litigation "
       "hold instruction, a permissions audit, access revocations, a requested forensic image, a completed "
       "exit interview, evidence storage of workstation SV-ENG-WS-014, closure of the incident ticket, and a "
       "note that the \"[m]atter [was] referred to legal counsel at Callister, Voss & Greenbaum LLP\" — the "
       "same firm that filed this action — followed by a forensic report dated March 5, 2018. Complaint "
       "paragraphs 97 and 109 nonetheless allege that \"SkyVault first discovered the misappropriation of its "
       "trade secrets upon reviewing Meridian's PathForge white paper published in or about July 2022.\" "
       "Whether that allegation can be reconciled with SkyVault's own 2018 incident record is a factual "
       "question for discovery and for Question L-11. It is identified here as a tension in the supplied "
       "documents, not as a conclusion about accrual or limitations."),

 ("h2", "F.  Material not supplied, and how each gap is handled"),
 ("p", "The following are not in the package. Each is converted below into an interview confirmation or a "
       "collection request, and none is treated as established in either direction:"),
 ("bullet", "The March 12, 2024 Callister, Voss & Greenbaum cease-and-desist letter (Complaint para. 61; response letter Re line)."),
 ("bullet", "Complaint Exhibits A, B, C (the '561, '227 and '889 patents), Exhibit D (Copyright Registration No. TX 9-142-338), and the complete Exhibit G — specifically white paper Section 6 and the appendices."),
 ("bullet", "The 12,797 unselected Confluence and endpoint events referenced at \"Report Metadata\" cell B13, and any file-level manifest of the 4,700 files at Row # 34."),
 ("bullet", "SkyVault's personnel file for Holt, any Section 5.1 written invention disclosures, the exit-interview record, any Section 3.5(c) written certification, incident ticket INC-2018-00417, alert ALT-2018-0209-0041, the SV-ENG-WS-014 forensic image and the examiner's findings, and the USB device itself."),
 ("bullet", "Any AeroCore firmware, and any instance of navfusion.c, pathoptengine.h, or swarm_proto.cpp."),
 ("bullet", "Meridian's PathForge repositories and full commit history, dependency and license manifests, open-source review records, build and release records, test harnesses and raw test data, and customer deployment records."),
 ("bullet", "Meridian's onboarding file for Holt, its IP and compliance policies and their outputs, its preservation notices and custodian lists, and any internal provenance or similarity analysis."),
 ("bullet", "The DroneNav repository (github.com/dronenav/dronenav), its license, and any Meridian clone, fork, or evaluation record; the RoboNav repository (github.com/mholt-robotics/robonav-cal) and Holt's Georgia Tech dissertation."),
 ("bullet", "Any Meridian-SkyVault correspondence after April 5, 2024 and before the October 2, 2024 filing."),

 # ---------------------------------------------------------------- Section III
 ("h1", "III.  INTERVIEW CONVENTIONS"),
 ("h2", "A.  Annotation format"),
 ("p", "Every question below is followed by two annotations. \"Source:\" names the file and, where the "
       "material permits, locates the lead within it — by complaint paragraph, agreement section or "
       "subsection, Exhibit A table row, white paper section, subsection or table, worksheet name, "
       "\"Row #\" value, worksheet row, cell reference, event date and time zone, event type, file or "
       "object name, device identifier, ticket or alert reference, or record ID. Where a question rests "
       "on more than one material, the annotation states separately which proposition each source "
       "supports; file names are never merely listed."),
 ("p", "\"Evidentiary purpose:\" states what the answer is for — which allegation, defense, element, or "
       "collection decision it advances — and, where relevant, what the answer cannot do. Citation keys "
       "used below: \"Complaint para. n\" refers to skyvault-complaint.docx; \"ECIAA Sec. n\" and "
       "\"ECIAA Exhibit A\" refer to holt-eciaa-agreement.docx; \"White Paper Sec. n\" refers to "
       "pathforge-whitepaper-excerpt.docx; \"Response Letter\" refers to meridian-cd-response.docx, cited "
       "by page paragraph; and \"Exhibit F\" refers to exhibit-f-forensic-log.xlsx, cited by worksheet, "
       "\"Row #\" value, and cell."),
 ("h2", "B.  Open-ended phrasing"),
 ("p", "Questions that seek a fact the witness must supply are framed openly — \"describe,\" \"walk me "
       "through,\" \"what became of,\" \"who,\" \"when\" — and do not embed the answer. Questions that "
       "test a document put the document to the witness and ask for confirmation or correction rather "
       "than asking the witness to adopt it. No question below asks a witness to agree that SkyVault's "
       "information was misappropriated, that PathForge was independently developed, that preservation "
       "was complete, that any license was obtained, or that any technology came from any particular "
       "source. Where a distinction matters, the question enumerates the alternatives so the witness must "
       "choose among them — see Question H-26, which separates awareness, citation, evaluation, cloning, "
       "dependency incorporation, modification, shipped use, and non-use."),
 ("h2", "C.  Privilege and work-product handling"),
 ("p", "The legal-lead questions in Part VI are deliberately bifurcated. Facts that are ordinarily "
       "discoverable — dates of receipt, routing, distribution lists, hold notices, custodian identities, "
       "what was gathered and transmitted, which policies exist and what they produced — are asked "
       "directly. Communications seeking or conveying legal advice, counsel's mental impressions, "
       "assessments of the strength of SkyVault's claims, the reasoning behind the positions taken in the "
       "April 5, 2024 letter, and the substance of any settlement discussion are not asked, and if a "
       "witness volunteers them the interviewer should note the topic, stop, and log it rather than "
       "develop it. Question L-3 states this boundary on the face of the question so the record shows the "
       "limit was observed."),
 ("h2", "D.  Preliminary matter for the Holt interview"),
 ("p", "Before Dr. Holt is interviewed, two threshold determinations must be made and documented: whether "
       "an Upjohn-type warning is required and in what terms, and whether his interests diverge from "
       "Meridian's such that he should be advised to retain separate counsel. The reason is on the face of "
       "the pleading. Holt is named personally as the actor in Complaint paragraphs 94 and 107 and Count "
       "VII is pleaded on his contractual obligations at paragraphs 127 through 132, while Meridian's "
       "liability is framed as derivative at paragraph 130 and Prayer paragraph 5 seeks a judgment that "
       "\"Meridian, through Holt, has breached\" the ECIAA. Question L-9 develops the factual state of "
       "representation and communication so that this determination can be made on information rather "
       "than assumption. It is a reason to interview Holt last, not a reason to avoid him."),
]
"
}

{
  "content": "# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Content module: Part IV — Dr. Marcus Holt."""

HOLT_INTRO = [
 ("h1", "IV.  WITNESS GROUP A — DR. MARCUS HOLT (Co-Founder and CTO, Meridian Dynamics, Inc.)"),
 ("p", "Dr. Holt is the only person named in the supplied materials who stands at the intersection of all "
       "six lead families: he signed the ECIAA and initialed its Exhibit A prior-invention disclosure, he "
       "is the account holder \"mholt\" to whom every one of the 38 user-attributed rows in Exhibit F is "
       "assigned, he is the cover-page author of the July 2022 PathForge white paper and the named "
       "technical leader of PathForge development from April 2018, and he is the individual SkyVault "
       "personally identifies as the misappropriator. He is therefore the witness whose account must "
       "either reconcile the five documents or expose where they cannot be reconciled, and his interview "
       "should be conducted as an open reconstruction of 2014 through 2024 rather than as a confrontation "
       "with anyone's conclusions."),
 ("p", "Two constraints govern this section. First, the only SkyVault-side account of his conduct is a "
       "50-row selected extract drawn from a 12,847-event population, prepared by a vendor retained by "
       "SkyVault's counsel and marked as that counsel's work product; it has never been authenticated by "
       "him, and it should be put to him only after his own account has been taken and only after the "
       "handling question in Part II.E has been resolved. Second, the threshold determinations described "
       "in Part III.D — Upjohn warning and separate-counsel assessment — must be made and documented "
       "before the interview begins, because Count VII is pleaded against his own contractual obligations "
       "while Meridian's liability is pleaded as derivative."),
 ("p", "Interview format: two sessions. Session one covers lead families 1 and 2 (Questions H-1 through "
       "H-14) and should be completed before the technical-team interviews, so that his account of his "
       "SkyVault tenure and his disclosed prior work can be tested against repository and dependency "
       "records. Session two covers lead families 3 through 6 (Questions H-15 through H-31) and should be "
       "conducted last, for the reasons given in Part VII. Do not show him Exhibit F, the white paper, or "
       "the complaint before the corresponding open questions have been asked and recorded."),
]

HOLT = [
 # ---------------- Lead family 1: employment and access history
 ("h3", "Lead family 1 — Employment, role, and access history at SkyVault"),

 ("H-1",
  "Please describe your role and day-to-day responsibilities at SkyVault, from your first day through "
  "your departure — what you were hired to do, who you reported to, which projects you owned, and how "
  "any of that changed over the twenty months you were there.",
  "ECIAA Recitals (\"Employee has been offered and has accepted the position of Senior Systems Engineer "
  "with the Company, commencing on June 13, 2016\") and Sec. 1.1 (duties stated as \"research, "
  "development, and engineering of UAV flight control systems, sensor fusion algorithms, flight path "
  "optimization, and related technologies,\" reporting to \"the Chief Executive Officer, Dr. Rajan "
  "Mehta\"), Sec. 1.3 (start date June 13, 2016) — these establish only the contractual job description "
  "as of June 13, 2016. Complaint paras. 43-44 supply the asserted tenure (\"Senior Systems Engineer on "
  "June 13, 2016,\" resignation \"effective February 16, 2018,\" \"approximately twenty-month tenure\") "
  "and the assertion of \"broad access\" to TS-1, TS-2, TS-4 and TS-5, plus TS-3 \"through his "
  "participation in customer demonstrations and proposal development\" — an allegation, not a finding. "
  "Exhibit F, \"Forensic Log\" Rows # 1-# 26, records which Confluence spaces the \"mholt\" account "
  "actually touched (/SkyVault/Engineering/SensorFusion/, /FlightPath/, /SwarmProtocol/, "
  "/HardwareIntegration/, and /SkyVault/Business/CustomerData/) — machine-generated access events, not "
  "evidence of what work he performed.",
  "Establishes from the witness's own account the actual scope of his duties, which is the predicate for "
  "the access element pleaded at Complaint para. 44 and for measuring whether the spaces his account used "
  "match the work he says he did. The three sources prove three different things — a contract term, an "
  "allegation of breadth, and a set of logged events — and the answer must be tested against SkyVault HR "
  "records, project assignments, and performance documentation, none of which is supplied."),

 ("H-2",
  "Walk me through how you actually reached technical information at SkyVault — which systems you used, "
  "how you were granted permission to each, and whether there were systems holding engineering material "
  "that you did not use.",
  "Exhibit F, \"Report Metadata\" cell B7 (Scope of Review limited to \"All Confluence workspace and "
  "endpoint security events for user account 'mholt' (Dr. Marcus Holt, Senior Systems Engineer) during "
  "the period January 1, 2018 through February 28, 2018\") and cell B8 (Data Sources: \"SkyVault "
  "Confluence Server v6.12.2 audit logs; Endpoint Security Agent (v4.1) event logs; Active Directory "
  "authentication logs; USB device connection registry\") — these establish that four named sources were "
  "reviewed and that no source-code management system was among them. Exhibit F, \"Forensic Log\" Rows "
  "# 41-# 43 (ADMIN_ACTION \"Permissions audit initiated for user mholt across all Engineering "
  "subspaces,\" 02/13/2018 08:08:32 AM CT; ACCESS_REVOKED for /SkyVault/ [All Spaces]; "
  "VPN_ACCESS_REVOKED) and Rows # 44, # 47, # 48 (LOGIN_FAILED \"Failed — Access Revoked\" 02/13/2018 "
  "09:44:51 AM CT; ACCOUNT_DEACTIVATED and EMAIL_ACCESS_REVOKED for mholt@skyvaulttech.com on "
  "02/16/2018) — these show the systems from which access was withdrawn, which is the best available "
  "in-package indicator of the systems that existed.",
  "Scopes the copyright count's access element and our own collection obligations at the same time. "
  "Because SkyVault's review never reached a source-code system, the extract cannot show whether Holt "
  "reached the files named at Complaint paras. 33, 116 and 118; his answer identifies which additional "
  "systems must be requested from SkyVault and which Meridian systems fall inside our own hold."),

 ("H-3",
  "Did you ever have access to SkyVault's AeroCore firmware source code? If so, describe where it lived, "
  "what form you saw it in, who else could reach it, and what controls applied.",
  "Complaint paras. 32-34 (AeroCore \"created by SkyVault employees within the scope of their "
  "employment\"; source files designated \"navfusion.c, pathoptengine.h, and swarm_proto.cpp\"; "
  "developed \"including during the period of Dr. Holt's employment from 2016 through 2018\") and para. "
  "44 (asserting Holt's access to AeroCore \"technical details\"), para. 119 (alleging on information and "
  "belief that Holt \"had access to SkyVault's AeroCore source code ... and copied, modified, and/or "
  "incorporated substantial portions of that code into Meridian's PathForge firmware\") — these are "
  "SkyVault's assertions. Exhibit F, \"Forensic Log\" Rows # 1-# 50 — no row references AeroCore, "
  "navfusion.c, pathoptengine.h, swarm_proto.cpp, or any version-control system, and \"Report Metadata\" "
  "cell B8 confirms why: no code repository was a data source. The absence is a gap in SkyVault's own "
  "exhibit, not evidence in either direction.",
  "Separates the pleaded access allegation from anything the supplied forensic extract records. His "
  "answer determines whether documented access to the three named files exists anywhere, which directs a "
  "targeted request to SkyVault's repository, build-server, and VPN records. Without that, Complaint "
  "para. 119 rests on pleading alone."),

 ("H-4",
  "Describe your final two weeks at SkyVault — when and how you gave notice, your last working day, your "
  "exit interview, and everything you were asked to return, delete, or certify.",
  "ECIAA Sec. 3.5(a)-(c) (on termination, promptly return all Company Materials, \"permanently delete or "
  "destroy all electronic copies ... stored on any personal devices, accounts, or media,\" and \"certify "
  "in writing to the Company\" compliance), Sec. 3.5 closing sentence (\"Employee shall not retain any "
  "copies, summaries, excerpts, or reproductions\"), and Sec. 4.4 (duty to \"participate in an exit "
  "interview and complete all required separation procedures\") — these establish what he was "
  "contractually required to do. Exhibit F, \"Forensic Log\" Row # 40 (ADMIN_NOTE, bthornton, 02/12/2018 "
  "11:15:09 AM CT: \"Confirmed with HR Director K. Patel — exit interview for M. Holt scheduled "
  "02/15/2018. IT to preserve all logs and endpoint data per litigation hold.\") and Row # 46 (ADMIN_NOTE, "
  "02/15/2018 10:30:22 AM CT: \"Exit interview for M. Holt completed by HR. Employee declined to return "
  "or identify USB device. Laptop SV-ENG-WS-014 retained by IT for forensic imaging.\") — these are an IT "
  "administrator's second-hand notes of what HR told him, inside a party-commissioned exhibit; they are "
  "not a transcript. Complaint para. 52 (alleging Holt \"did not return the USB storage device or the "
  "files contained thereon ... nor did he certify the destruction of any copies\").",
  "Tests the one in-package statement about the exit interview against the only person who attended it, "
  "and establishes whether any Sec. 3.5(c) written certification was requested, delivered, refused, or "
  "waived — a discrete document whose existence is decisive for Count VII and which is not in the "
  "supplied set. What he was told at the interview is a fact; what SkyVault's counsel later concluded "
  "about it is not, and is not sought."),

 ("H-5",
  "At any point before you left SkyVault, were you made aware of any alert, question, investigation, or "
  "concern about your file transfers or your handling of company data? Describe what you were told and by "
  "whom.",
  "Exhibit F, \"Forensic Log\" Row # 34 (Flag/Alert: \"ALERT — Bulk transfer to removable media exceeds "
  "threshold (>500 files)\"; Notes: \"Automated alert generated by Endpoint Security Agent\"), Row # 38 "
  "(ADMIN_REVIEW_FLAG, 02/12/2018 09:33:21 AM CT, \"Alert Queue — Ref: ALT-2018-0209-0041,\" Flag "
  "\"FLAGGED — Escalated to HR,\" Notes \"Ref incident ticket INC-2018-00417\"), Rows # 39-# 40, # 45, "
  "# 46, # 49, # 50 (all bthornton or SYSTEM entries dated 02/12 through 02/16/2018), and Row # 50 Notes "
  "(\"Matter referred to legal counsel at Callister, Voss & Greenbaum LLP\") — every escalation row "
  "post-dates the Row # 34 transfer, so the extract itself does not show advance notice to Holt. "
  "Complaint para. 51 (alleging the event \"was flagged by SkyVault's IT administrator on February 12, "
  "2018\").",
  "Bears on knowledge and state of mind, which drive the willfulness and maliciousness allegations at "
  "Complaint paras. 63, 69-70, 78, 86, 100, 112, 121 and 147-150, and the enhanced, exemplary and "
  "punitive damages sought. Only his testimony plus SkyVault's HR and incident files — ticket "
  "INC-2018-00417 and alert ALT-2018-0209-0041, neither supplied — can establish what he knew and when. "
  "The answer must not be assumed from the escalation rows, which say nothing about communication to him."),

 ("H-6",
  "Describe the file transfers recorded against your account in January and February 2018 — what you were "
  "doing, why you were doing it, where the files went, and whether anyone authorized or knew about it.",
  "Exhibit F, \"Forensic Log\" Rows # 5, # 8, # 11, # 14, # 15, # 18, # 21, # 24, # 26 (nine single-file "
  "FILE_DOWNLOAD events between 01/10/2018 and 02/01/2018 to \"Local Disk "
  "(C:\\Users\\mholt\\Downloads),\" including source-code objects sf_point_cloud_processor_v1.4.py and "
  "swarm_failover_logic_v1.2.py, none flagged), Rows # 27-# 32 (six BULK_EXPORT events, 02/02 through "
  "02/08/2018, to \"Local Disk (C:\\Users\\mholt\\Downloads\\export_020218 / _020518 / _020618 / _020718 "
  "/ _020818a / _020818b),\" totaling 1,526 files and 9,682.0 MB), Row # 33 (USB_DEVICE_CONNECTED, "
  "2018-02-09T02:17:44Z, Event Time (CT) \"08:17:44 PM (02/08 CT),\" Device ID "
  "\"USB\\VID_0781&PID_5581\\4C530001221029118035 (SanDisk Ultra 128GB)\"), Row # 34 "
  "(BULK_COPY_TO_REMOVABLE, 2018-02-09T02:18:12Z, Event Time (CT) \"08:18:12 PM (02/08 CT),\" Source "
  "System \"Endpoint Security Agent / Confluence Export,\" Source Path \"/SkyVault/Engineering/ [Multiple "
  "Spaces],\" File/Object Name \"[Multiple — see File Count],\" 4,700 files / 18,473.2 MB, Destination "
  "\"Removable Disk (F:\\SkyVault_Export\\)\"), Row # 35 (USB_DEVICE_DISCONNECTED, 2018-02-09T03:42:58Z, "
  "\"09:42:58 PM (02/08 CT)\"). Complaint paras. 48 and 50 both date the event \"February 9, 2018,\" and "
  "para. 50 asserts that Exhibit F \"identifies the date, time, file count, and destination device.\" "
  "ECIAA Sec. 4.2 (bar on connecting personal storage devices or transferring Company data \"without the "
  "prior written approval of Employee's supervisor or the Company's IT department\").",
  "Produces the account of a two-stage process — Confluence to local disk over seven days, then local "
  "disk to removable media — which the complaint's single-event framing at paras. 48 and 50 does not "
  "describe. It also opens the two most concrete document-anchored lines in the matter: the extract's "
  "Event Date column reading 02/09/2018 while its own Event Time (CT) column reads \"(02/08 CT)\" for all "
  "three USB rows, and the 3,174 files and 8,791.2 MB by which Row # 34 exceeds the six logged staging "
  "exports. His explanation of routine working downloads also bears on whether the nine unflagged "
  "single-file events were ordinary course, and whether any ECIAA Sec. 4.2 written approval exists."),

 ("H-7",
  "What became of the SanDisk Ultra 128GB drive recorded as connected to your workstation, and of the "
  "folder \"F:\\SkyVault_Export\\\"? Where are they now, and who has held them since?",
  "Exhibit F, \"Forensic Log\" Rows # 33-# 35 (device identifier "
  "\"USB\\VID_0781&PID_5581\\4C530001221029118035 (SanDisk Ultra 128GB)\"; destination \"Removable Disk "
  "(F:\\SkyVault_Export\\)\"), Row # 45 (ADMIN_NOTE 02/14/2018 08:12:07 AM CT: \"Forensic image of "
  "workstation SV-ENG-WS-014 requested. Hargrove Forensics Group engaged per counsel authorization.\"), "
  "Row # 46 (\"Employee declined to return or identify USB device. Laptop SV-ENG-WS-014 retained by IT "
  "for forensic imaging.\"), Row # 49 (\"Workstation SV-ENG-WS-014 secured in IT evidence storage. "
  "Forensic imaging by Hargrove Forensics Group scheduled for 02/19/2018.\"); \"Report Metadata\" cell B12 "
  "(\"Server image acquired 02/19/2018 by T. Hargrove; verified hash SHA-256: 9a3f...d82e; stored in "
  "evidence locker HFG-2018-0034\") — note the truncated hash, and that it is for a server image with no "
  "device-level record for the USB media. Complaint para. 52.",
  "Establishes the present existence, location and custody of the only physical repository of the files "
  "SkyVault says were taken, and whether the SV-ENG-WS-014 image still contains the six \"export_*\" "
  "staging folders identified at Rows # 27-# 32. That determines whether any file-level comparison is "
  "possible at all, and whether the 3,174-file gap can be closed from the imaged workstation. This is a "
  "collection question; nothing here assumes the drive survives or that it was preserved."),

 ("H-8",
  "Did you bring any SkyVault file, document, drive, note, dataset, or code into Meridian — at formation "
  "in April 2018 or at any time since? If so, describe each item, where it went, and who else had it.",
  "Complaint paras. 49 and 54 (alleging on information and belief that the download included all five "
  "trade-secret categories and that Holt \"used the files he misappropriated from SkyVault to develop the "
  "core technology underlying Meridian's PathForge platform\"), para. 55 (alleging disclosure \"to "
  "Meridian's other employees and engineers\"), paras. 94-95 and 107-108 (DTSA and TUTSA acquisition and "
  "use through Holt \"with knowledge or reason to know\"), para. 130 (Meridian \"knowingly received, "
  "accepted, and exploited\") and para. 136 (\"Meridian was aware, or should have been aware\") — all of "
  "these are allegations. ECIAA Sec. 2.4 (\"Company Materials\" definition), Sec. 3.1(c) (no use \"for "
  "any purpose other than the performance of Employee's duties\"), Sec. 3.5, Sec. 5.2 — these establish "
  "the obligations whose breach is alleged. Response Letter para. 3 (\"Meridian denies these allegations "
  "in their entirety. Meridian independently developed its PathForge platform through the efforts of its "
  "engineering teams\") — a party position. White Paper Sec. 7.2 closing paragraph (\"All PathForge "
  "technology was developed independently by the Meridian engineering team\") — a 2022 published "
  "assertion.",
  "This is the central contested fact of Counts IV, V, VI and VII, and the three supplied documents take "
  "opposite positions without any of them proving anything: the complaint pleads transfer and use on "
  "information and belief, the response letter denies and asserts independent development, and the white "
  "paper repeats that assertion publicly. The answer must be elicited openly and then tested against "
  "Meridian's onboarding records, device images, repository ingestion history, and any 2018 import logs — "
  "none supplied. Neither the allegation nor the denial may be treated as a finding."),

 # ---------------- Lead family 2: disclosed prior work
 ("h3", "Lead family 2 — Prior work disclosed on ECIAA Exhibit A"),

 ("H-9",
  "Exhibit A to your SkyVault agreement lists two prior inventions. Please describe each — what it did, "
  "when and how you built it, who else contributed, what became of it after June 2016, and what "
  "documentation of it still exists.",
  "ECIAA Exhibit A — Prior Inventions Disclosure, Table Row 1: \"Autonomous Ground Vehicle Path Planning "
  "Algorithm | 2014-2015 | Developed as part of PhD dissertation research at Georgia Institute of "
  "Technology; no patent filed\"; Table Row 2: \"RoboNav Sensor Calibration Toolkit (open-source) | 2015 | "
  "Published on GitHub under MIT License; available at github.com/mholt-robotics/robonav-cal\"; the "
  "Exhibit A preamble (\"a complete list of all Prior Inventions (as defined in Section 5.3 ...)\") and "
  "the closing \"Employee Initials: _M.H._\" dated June 13, 2016. ECIAA Sec. 5.3 (the Agreement \"does "
  "not apply to an Invention that Employee develops entirely on Employee's own time without using the "
  "Company's equipment, supplies, facilities, or Confidential Information,\" subject to carve-backs (a) "
  "relating to SkyVault's business or \"actual or demonstrably anticipated research or development\" and "
  "(b) resulting \"from any work performed by Employee for the Company\"). ECIAA Recitals (PhD in "
  "Robotics, Georgia Institute of Technology, 2015). Complaint para. 128(b) (alleging breach by "
  "\"[f]ailing to assign to SkyVault inventions conceived or reduced to practice during his "
  "employment\").",
  "Exhibit A is the only document in the package that identifies pre-SkyVault work Holt contractually "
  "carved out of the Sec. 5.2 assignment, and it is therefore the documentary anchor for any argument "
  "that PathForge's path-planning and calibration functionality descends from 2014-2015 work rather than "
  "from SkyVault's TS-1 and TS-2 categories (Complaint paras. 38(a)-(b), 91(a)-(b), 105(a)-(b)). It proves "
  "only that these items were disclosed and excluded in June 2016 — not that they were used at Meridian, "
  "not that they anticipate any PathForge module, and not that the list is complete. The dissertation "
  "record and the RoboNav commit history must be collected and independently dated."),

 ("H-10",
  "The RoboNav Sensor Calibration Toolkit was published under an MIT license in 2015. Did any part of it, "
  "or any calibration method in it, end up in PathForge? If so, which parts, when, and how was the "
  "provenance documented?",
  "ECIAA Exhibit A Table Row 2 (RoboNav Sensor Calibration Toolkit, 2015, MIT License, "
  "github.com/mholt-robotics/robonav-cal) and Sec. 5.3 — these establish that a licensed, open-source "
  "calibration toolkit was disclosed as pre-employment work. White Paper Sec. 7.2, bullet \"Q3 2018 - Q4 "
  "2019\" (\"Iterative prototyping and testing refined the EKF implementation, sensor calibration "
  "pipeline, and occupancy grid algorithms for commercial-grade reliability\") and Sec. 3.2, Step 3 "
  "(\"IMU readings are corrected for known bias and scale factor errors using online calibration "
  "estimates\") — these show that PathForge contains a calibration subsystem that the white paper "
  "describes but does not attribute to any source. Complaint paras. 33 and 116 (SkyVault's asserted "
  "ownership of AeroCore source files) and para. 38(a) (TS-1).",
  "Connects a disclosed, licensed prior invention to a specific PathForge subsystem whose provenance the "
  "published document leaves open. The distinction matters twice: for Count VII, because Sec. 5.2(a) turns "
  "on whether the invention was \"conceived or reduced to practice during the period of Employee's "
  "employment\"; and for Counts IV and VI, because calibration code descending from Holt's 2015 MIT "
  "repository is a different thing from calibration code descending from SkyVault. Requires the RoboNav "
  "commit history and the PathForge calibration module's repository history, neither supplied."),

 ("H-11",
  "Between June 13, 2016 and February 16, 2018, did you conceive, create, or reduce to practice anything "
  "you regarded as your own rather than SkyVault's? What did you disclose in writing under Section 5.1, "
  "when, and to whom?",
  "ECIAA Sec. 5.1 (duty to \"promptly and fully disclose to the Company, in writing, any and all "
  "Inventions that Employee conceives, creates, develops, reduces to practice, or makes (whether alone or "
  "jointly with others) during the period of Employee's employment ... whether during business hours or "
  "otherwise, and whether on or off Company premises\"), Sec. 5.2(a)-(b) (present assignment of Inventions "
  "\"conceived or reduced to practice during the period of Employee's employment\" and \"related to the "
  "Company's current business or reasonably anticipated research, development, or business activities, as "
  "determined by the Company in its reasonable discretion\"), Sec. 2.3 (\"Inventions\" defined to include "
  "\"algorithms, software, firmware ... whether or not patentable or copyrightable, and whether or not "
  "reduced to practice\"), Sec. 5.4 (work made for hire plus a back-up copyright assignment), Sec. 5.5 "
  "(surviving cooperation duty). Complaint paras. 46(b), 70 (Sec. 5 summary), 128(b), 129.",
  "Count VII(b) turns entirely on whether any PathForge-relevant conception fell inside the June 2016 to "
  "February 2018 window. Any written Sec. 5.1 disclosures are the primary evidence and are not supplied; "
  "the answer directs a targeted request to SkyVault's HR and IP-docket records. His contemporaneous "
  "belief also bears on the Sec. 5.3 exclusion and on the willfulness and maliciousness allegations at "
  "Complaint paras. 100, 112 and 121."),

 ("H-12",
  "Describe any work you did relating to UAV navigation, sensor fusion, path planning, or swarm "
  "coordination between your February 16, 2018 departure and Meridian's formation on April 11, 2018 — on "
  "what equipment, in what files, and with whom.",
  "Complaint para. 2 (Holt \"departed SkyVault and co-founded Meridian Dynamics, Inc. approximately two "
  "months later\"), paras. 9 and 53 (Meridian \"formed on April 11, 2018\"; co-founded \"on or about "
  "April 11, 2018\"), para. 54 (\"The rapid timeline between Holt's departure from SkyVault, the "
  "formation of Meridian, and the development of PathForge ... is consistent with Holt's unauthorized use "
  "of SkyVault's proprietary information\") — an inference from proximity, expressly on information and "
  "belief. White Paper Sec. 7.2 bullet \"April 2018\" (\"Meridian Dynamics, Inc. incorporated in "
  "Delaware. PathForge development begins under Dr. Marcus Holt's technical leadership\") and Sec. 1 "
  "(\"Developed from the ground up beginning in 2018\"). ECIAA Sec. 3.2(a) (trade-secret obligations "
  "continue \"in perpetuity\"), Sec. 3.4 (preserving the right to use \"the general skills, knowledge, "
  "experience, and expertise developed or acquired during Employee's employment\" and \"publicly "
  "available information and general industry knowledge\").",
  "Tests the complaint's central timeline inference against artifacts rather than assertion. The "
  "seven-week gap is where the case is most likely to be won or lost on documents, and any artifact from "
  "it — a personal repository, notebook, hardware purchase, or correspondence — must be located, dated "
  "and provenance-checked. The answer may support independent development, or it may create a new problem "
  "if material post-dating February 16, 2018 draws on SkyVault sources; neither possibility may be "
  "assumed. The ECIAA Sec. 3.4 residual-skills clause frames the lawful boundary the answer must be "
  "measured against."),

 ("H-13",
  "Did you participate in preparing, reviewing, or providing technical input for any SkyVault patent "
  "application? Were you told about, or did you see, the applications that became the '561, '227, or '889 "
  "patents?",
  "Complaint para. 28 ('561 Patent, \"filed on March 14, 2017,\" issued September 18, 2018, \"The named "
  "inventor is Dr. Rajan Mehta\"), para. 29 ('227 Patent, filed November 9, 2018 — after Holt's stated "
  "February 16, 2018 departure — inventors \"Dr. Rajan Mehta and Dr. Anita Venkatesh\"), para. 30 ('889 "
  "Patent, filed June 22, 2020, inventors \"Dr. Rajan Mehta, Dr. Anita Venkatesh, and Kevin Larsson\"), "
  "para. 69 (alleging Holt \"had actual knowledge of SkyVault's patented technology, including the '561 "
  "Patent, which was filed on March 14, 2017, during the course of Holt's employment,\" and \"[o]n "
  "information and belief, Holt was aware of the '561 Patent application and the subject matter claimed "
  "therein\"), paras. 78 and 86 (the same awareness asserted on information and belief for the '227 and "
  "'889). ECIAA Sec. 5.5 (surviving duty to \"execute any documents and take any actions reasonably "
  "necessary to perfect, protect, and enforce the Company's rights in Company Inventions, including "
  "filing and prosecuting patent applications\") and Sec. 5.6 (power of attorney).",
  "Willfulness under 35 U.S.C. Sec. 284 (Complaint paras. 72, 80, 88, 147) depends on actual knowledge. "
  "The '561 application was filed during his tenure; the '227 was filed roughly nine months after he left "
  "and the '889 more than two years after, so paras. 78 and 86 rest on information and belief alone. His "
  "answer distinguishes documented inventor or Sec. 5.5 cooperation involvement — which would appear in "
  "SkyVault's prosecution files and in any assignment or inventorship correspondence — from mere "
  "awareness, and identifies whether Meridian should seek those files. It also identifies whether Kevin "
  "Larsson or Dr. Anita Venkatesh are persons he worked with, which bears on Question H-14."),

 ("H-14",
  "Are you aware of any Meridian employee, contractor, founder, or advisor who previously worked at "
  "SkyVault, or of any contact between Meridian personnel and SkyVault personnel about technology? "
  "Describe each instance you can recall.",
  "ECIAA Sec. 7.1(a)-(b) (twelve-month post-termination bar on \"solicit[ing], recruit[ing], "
  "encourag[ing], or induc[ing] any employee of the Company to terminate his or her employment\" and on "
  "\"hir[ing] or engag[ing] any person who is, or was within the six (6) months prior to such hiring, an "
  "employee of the Company\"), Sec. 7.2 (reasonableness acknowledgment), Sec. 3.3(a) (permitted disclosure "
  "only to persons \"bound by confidentiality obligations no less restrictive\"), Sec. 9.8 (survival of "
  "Sec. 7 subject to its durational limit). Complaint para. 55 (alleging Holt \"disclosed SkyVault's "
  "trade secrets and confidential information to Meridian's other employees and engineers to facilitate "
  "the development of PathForge\"), para. 130 (Meridian \"knowingly received, accepted, and exploited\"), "
  "para. 10 (Meridian \"co-founded by Chief Executive Officer Priya Chandrasekaran and Chief Technology "
  "Officer Dr. Marcus Holt\").",
  "No count in the supplied complaint pleads a Sec. 7 breach, and on the pleaded dates the twelve-month "
  "period expired in February 2019; but any SkyVault-to-Meridian migration would supply the conduit that "
  "paras. 55 and 130 currently plead only on information and belief, and would materially change the "
  "technical-team interviews in Part V. Meridian's founder, employee, contractor and advisor roster is "
  "not supplied and must be collected. The question is an inquiry; it does not assume that any such "
  "hiring did or did not occur."),

 # ---------------- Lead family 3: PathForge development origins
 ("h3", "Lead family 3 — PathForge development origins, module by module"),

 ("H-15",
  "Take me through how PathForge development actually began in 2018 — who was in the room, what was "
  "written or drawn first, what you had available to work from, and what the first working version could "
  "do.",
  "White Paper Sec. 1 (\"Developed from the ground up beginning in 2018\"; \"reached commercial launch in "
  "September 2020\"; \"deployed by over 60 commercial customers across the logistics, agriculture, "
  "infrastructure inspection, and emergency response sectors\"), Sec. 2 (\"When Meridian Dynamics began "
  "development of PathForge in 2018 ... Dr. Marcus Holt, who holds a PhD in Robotics from Georgia "
  "Institute of Technology (2015), led the PathForge architecture design, drawing on his extensive "
  "academic background in autonomous systems and a thorough review of the published literature\"), Sec. "
  "7.2 bullet \"April 2018\" and closing paragraph — all of which are statements in a document marked "
  "\"Public Release / Marketing Technical Paper\" on its cover. Complaint paras. 54, 56 (PathForge "
  "launched \"in or about September 2020\"), 119-120 — the contrary allegation. Response Letter para. 3 — "
  "the same position restated to opposing counsel.",
  "The three supplied documents state two incompatible provenance narratives and none of them is evidence "
  "of what happened in 2018. His contemporaneous recollection, and above all the first-commit metadata, "
  "earliest design documents, and hardware procurement records that must be collected, are the only way "
  "to convert competing statements into facts. Note also that Sec. 2 attributes the architecture to a "
  "\"thorough review of the published literature,\" which is a claim about process that either produced "
  "artifacts or did not."),

 ("H-16",
  "The white paper describes four separately deployable modules. For each one — the multi-sensor fusion "

 # ---------------- Lead family 4: white paper title and authorship
 ("h3", "Lead family 4 — White paper title, authorship, review, and publication"),

 ("H-21",

 # ---------------- Lead family 5: DroneNav and other public sources
 ("h3", "Lead family 5 — DroneNav and other public sources"),

 ("H-25",

  "provided a valuable reference point for the broader community and informed numerous subsequent "
  "research efforts and commercial implementations\"), Sec. 4.1 (\"significant prior work including the "
  "DroneNav open-source project (2017)\"), Sec. 4.2, Sec. 4.3 closing paragraph (\"PathForge's "
  "implementation extends the foundational VIO-based navigation demonstrated in projects like "

  "flight path optimization models\"), paras. 39, 41, 92 and 106 (independent economic value and not "

 ("H-26",
  "Take me through exactly what Meridian did with DroneNav. Please address each of these separately: "

  "incorporating any part of it as a dependency; modifying it; using it in shipped PathForge code; and "

  "White Paper Sec. 2 (DroneNav \"informed numerous subsequent research efforts and commercial "
  "implementations\"), Sec. 4.2 (\"Open-source implementations such as the DroneNav project (2017) have "
  "demonstrated the viability of sliding-window VIO for GPS-denied UAV flight. DroneNav's publicly "
  "available codebase implemented the core pipeline of feature tracking, sliding-window optimization, "
  "keyframe management, and IMU pre-integration for monocular camera configurations,\" followed by "
  "PathForge's three claimed improvements: \"(1) multi-scale feature tracking that maintains tracking "
  "accuracy in low-texture environments ..., (2) adaptive keyframe selection based on information gain "
  "rather than fixed temporal or spatial intervals ..., and (3) tightly-coupled LiDAR-VIO fusion as a "
  "fallback mode\"), Sec. 7.2 bullet \"Q1 2019 - Q3 2020\" (\"PathForge's VIO pipeline was developed "

  "well-known concepts and incorporating code is real and documented. Forcing the eight-way distinction "

 ("H-27",

 ("H-28",
  "Beyond DroneNav, Vasquez, Nakamura and Okonkwo, and Ferreira, what other published or open-source work "
  "did you review when designing PathForge? For each, tell me whether you read it, cited it, evaluated "
  "it, implemented from it, or did not use it — and whether Meridian retains the review artifacts.",
  "White Paper Sec. 2 (Vasquez, \"Multi-Sensor Fusion for Autonomous UAV Navigation,\" IEEE Transactions "
  "on Robotics, Vol. 32, No. 5, October 2016, described as \"a foundational contribution establishing "
  "the viability of combining LiDAR point cloud data, stereo vision depth maps, and inertial measurement "
  "unit (IMU) readings through an extended Kalman filter framework for real-time obstacle detection and "
  "avoidance in UAV applications,\" and \"other foundational contributions in Kalman filter design for "
  "multi-sensor state estimation (see Nakamura and Okonkwo, 2015)\"), Sec. 3.1 closing (\"This "
  "architecture ... follows the general approach established by Vasquez (2016) and represents a "
  "commercially optimized implementation of that foundational methodology\"), Sec. 3.2 closing (\"directly "
  "implements the framework described by Vasquez (2016), adapted and optimized for commercial-grade "
  "reliability and performance\"), Sec. 5.2 (\"The protocol design draws on well-established principles "
  "from distributed systems and mobile ad hoc networking (MANET) literature ... (see Ferreira et al., "
  "2016)\"), Sec. 7.2 bullets, References items 1-4. Complaint paras. 38(a), (b) and (d) (TS-1, TS-2, "

  "UAV industry\"), para. 67 claim chart row 1[f] (EKF with adaptive weighting).",
  "The prior-art record is the affirmative case against trade-secret status for the algorithmic concepts "
  "SkyVault claims as TS-1, TS-2 and TS-4, and Meridian's own public statement that these were "
  "\"well-known\" foundations is the starting point. Testing whether Holt can identify the specific "

 ("H-29",
  "Did you, or anyone at Meridian to your knowledge, ever review, benchmark, reverse-engineer, or receive "

  "2024 letter \"addressed to Priya Chandrasekaran, CEO, at Meridian's headquarters in Austin, Texas,\" "
  "with the three demands), para. 62 (April 5, 2024 response), para. 63 (\"Meridian has continued to "
  "make, use, sell, and offer for sale the infringing PathForge platform\" after \"actual notice\").",
  "Fixes Holt's personal knowledge date, which is the starting point for any preservation duty he "
  "personally bore and for assessing the willfulness narrative that rests on post-notice conduct at "
  "Complaint para. 63 and paras. 69-70, 78 and 86. The April 5 no-contact request at P0018 is itself "
  "relevant: it establishes that counsel asked SkyVault to route around employees, which bears on whether "
  "any later SkyVault contact with Meridian personnel occurred. Elicit facts only — dates, receipt, what "
  "he did, what he preserved. Do not ask what counsel told him about the merits, which is privileged."),

 ("H-31",
  "From March 12, 2024 to today, what steps did you personally take to preserve documents, devices, code, "
  "communications, and personal storage relating to PathForge, your SkyVault employment, or this dispute? "
  "Describe what you held, what you retained, and what you did not.",
  "Complaint para. 61 (March 12, 2024 letter), para. 63 (continued conduct after notice), Exhibit List "
  "entry \"Exhibit F\" (\"IT Forensic Log Excerpt, prepared by Hargrove Forensics Group, documenting the "
  "February 9, 2018 file transfer event\"), Prayer paras. 8 and 17 (permanent injunction; impoundment and "
  "destruction of infringing materials under 17 U.S.C. Sec. 503). Exhibit F, \"Report Metadata\" cell B13 "
  "(\"Full audit log contains 12,847 events for the review period; 50 events selected\"), cell B14 "
  "(\"CONFIDENTIAL — ATTORNEY WORK PRODUCT / PREPARED IN ANTICIPATION OF LITIGATION\"), \"Forensic Log\" "
  "Row # 40 (SkyVault's own note: \"IT to preserve all logs and endpoint data per litigation hold\"), "
  "Rows # 45 and # 49 (imaging requested; workstation secured in evidence storage). Response Letter item "
  "3 (declining source-code access).",
  "Preservation is a fact question with definite answers — what was held, when, by whom, and what was "
  "collected — and Holt's personal devices and accounts are within his own control in a way no other "
  "custodian's are. Row # 40 shows SkyVault imposing a hold in February 2018; the corresponding "
  "Meridian-side record is absent from the supplied set and is essential both to defensibility and to any "
  "later spoliation dispute, particularly given the impoundment and destruction exposure at Prayer para. "
  "17. Elicit the mechanics only; any instruction he received from counsel about preservation is "
  "privileged and should be logged rather than developed."),
]
",
